label: Prevent layout shifts with aspect ratio
description: Set `aspect-ratio` so nearby content does not jump while an image loads.

label: Balance heading text for easier reading
description: Use `text-balance` for headings and `text-pretty` for body copy.

label: Align numbers with tabular-nums
description: Use `tabular-nums` to align numbers in tables and data-heavy UI.

label: Use 44px touch targets for accessibility
description: Give buttons and controls a touch target of at least 44 by 44px.

label: Add scale feedback to pressed buttons
description: Add subtle press feedback with `:active` and a scale near 0.96.

label: Animate popovers from their trigger
description: Animate each popover from the control that opened it.

label: Group content with spacing, not dividers
description: Use spacing to group related content before adding divider lines.

label: Preview the next item in scroll lists
description: Show 16 to 32px of the next item to make horizontal scrolling clear.

label: Use neutral borders around images
description: Use a thin neutral outline instead of a tinted ring.

label: Truncate long titles in small spaces
description: Use `line-clamp` or `truncate` when space is tight.

label: Improve contrast for muted text
description: Give muted text enough color contrast to stay easy to read.

label: Avoid scale-zero entrance animations
description: Start entrance animations near 95% size instead of scaling up from zero.

label: Match loading skeletons to real content
description: Match loading skeletons to the content they replace, and skip spinners when possible.

label: Limit each view to one accent color
description: Use one accent per view. Keep secondary actions neutral.

label: Keep body text lines easy to read
description: Keep text lines between 60 and 75 characters for easier reading.

label: Use shadows to show visual depth
description: Use shadows to show depth. Use borders to show structure.

label: Add visible keyboard focus rings
description: Use `:focus-visible` to keep keyboard focus clear and visible.

label: Show form errors next to each field
description: Put each validation error directly below its field.

label: Add visible labels to every form field
description: Use a visible label. Do not use placeholder text as the only label.

label: Give empty states one clear action
description: Give an empty state one clear action, not just an explanation.

label: Use sentence case for UI labels
description: Write labels in sentence case, not all caps.

label: Never use color alone for status
description: Add text or an icon so status is never shown by color alone.

label: Use ease-out for entrance animations
description: Use `ease-out` for entrances. `ease-in` feels slow when something opens.

label: Align icons by eye for better balance
description: Nudge icons when geometric centering does not look visually balanced.

label: Match icon stroke weight to text
description: Use a 2px stroke beside semibold text and a 1.5px stroke beside regular text.

label: Use outline icons for default states
description: Use outline icons by default. Use a fill for the active state.

label: Avoid glow effects on primary buttons
description: Avoid glow effects on primary buttons; use contrast and spacing instead.

label: Animate icon state changes smoothly
description: Cross-fade changing icons with opacity, scale, and blur for smoother feedback.

label: Add space between nearby controls
description: Leave about 12px between nearby bordered controls.

label: Keep full-width buttons inside page margins
description: Keep full-width buttons inside the page margins, not edge to edge.

label: Use tighter line height for headings
description: Use a line height near 1.1 for short headings.

label: Adjust letter spacing for large text
description: Large display text often needs slightly tighter letter spacing.

label: Confirm destructive actions before they run
description: Ask for confirmation before deleting data or taking an irreversible action.

label: Fade the edges of scrollable lists
description: Use a `mask-image` fade to show where a scrollable list continues.

label: Stagger hero animations on first load
description: Stagger hero animations by about 100ms on first load, not during routine interactions.

label: Keep exit animations short and subtle
description: Keep exit animations short with a small `translateY` movement.

label: Show nearby tooltips faster
description: Show nearby tooltips faster after the first tooltip opens.

label: Use interruptible CSS transitions
description: Use CSS transitions for interactive open and close states.

label: Avoid repeated animations in routine UI
description: Animate first-load entrances, but keep repeated actions like tab switches instant.

label: Use ease-out instead of springs for feedback
description: Use `ease-out` for toggles and toasts because springs can wobble.

label: Fade menus out when they close
description: Close menus with a short fade. Do not move them far off screen.

label: Reserve brand colors for links and actions
description: Keep headings neutral. Use the brand color for links and actions.

label: Use solid modal backdrops instead of blur
description: Use a solid modal backdrop instead of blur to avoid expensive full-screen rendering.

label: Fade overflowing text instead of clipping it
description: Fade long labels instead of cutting them off with a hard ellipsis.

label: Use matching enter and exit animations
description: Use matching enter and exit animations so a surface feels connected.

label: Soften label changes with a short blur
description: Add a short blur when labels change to avoid a distracting visual flash.
